summary: This document constitutes a T-Mobile account activity log and transaction record for the billing period ending January 2026. The record documents critical milestones including device purchase, equipment installment plan (EIP) payments, and a device unlock notification. Forensically, this evidence establishes the timeline of hardware ownership and the subsequent unlock eligibility, which is relevant to the broader investigation into carrier-level administrative barriers.
